cases.reason: Attacked through the 2002-only debugging line. 2002's clause 7 preamble carries an extra sentence, absent in 2023 7.1, placing the inclusion or exclusion of debugging lines in the compilation stage, the same stage in which expansion may occur. So in 2002 the 'manner and time' determination also reaches a parameterized class whose source holds debugging lines. That does not change the requirement: the only constraint stays 'after the text manipulation stage', and debugging-line inclusion is decided by the class definition's own SOURCE-COMPUTER (2002 12.2.4.3 GR4), not by the order of expansion. Probe r166_param_debug.cob at --std 2002: an expansion of a class WITH DEBUGGING MODE compiles its fixed D and floating >>D lines; an expansion of a class without it treats a non-COBOL D line as a comment. Both row witnesses (pb759_parameterized_class, pb1522_replace_before_parameterized_expansion) MATCH their goldens at --std 2002 (refute-u-37/w). Side finding: SOURCE-COMPUTER. WITH DEBUGGING MODE. with no computer-name is refused at 2002 (COBOL1971); this is already filed as kb/Work PB5609.
